description: Tails Falco's JSON alert file and files Emergency, Alert, Critical, and Error rules as high signals and Warning and Notice rules as medium ones.
name: falco_feed

signals.description: A Falco rule fired at Emergency, Alert, Critical, or Error priority; one episode is one rule plus one output_fields digest.
signals.name: falco_critical

signals.description: A Falco rule fired at Warning or Notice priority; one episode is one rule plus one output_fields digest.
signals.name: falco_warning
